newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNLINES SAYS BUYS REST OF FINNLINK.
newsitem.headline: FINNLINES SAYS BUYS REST OF FINNLINK.

text.p: Finnish shipping group Finnlines Oy said on Wednesday it had raised its stake in shipping group Finnlink Oy to 100 percent from 76.5 percent.
"After the deal, Finnlines owns 100 percent of Finnlink," Finnlines said in a statement which gave no value for the deal.
Finnlines said it bought the rest of Finnlink from Palkkiyhtyma Oy.
Finnlink has been engaged in freight shipping between Finland and Sweden since 1989, and it operates three vessels between Naantali and Kapellskar, Finnlines said.
